messages:
zoe: FYI found a weird dup-gen in sample-app node when token refresh hits a 429 mid-stream. staging repro.

mike: can you paste the short logs? sounds like SDK fires a new Start instead of resume.

zoe: yep — two StartStream 150ms apart. payload identical, different stream ids. snippet: 
```
2026-03-10T09:03:21.100Z INFO StartStream req=a1 user=u-42 model=gpt-4o
2026-03-10T09:03:21.250Z WARN token_refresh for u-42
2026-03-10T09:03:21.260Z INFO StartStream req=a2 user=u-42 model=gpt-4o
```

ira: which SDK? node version? python ok?

zoe: node v1.8.2. python not reproing. sample-app only sets X-Request-ID. no idempotency header for stream starts.

phil: short-term mitigations: (1) client jitter on retry after refresh (random 100-500ms) to avoid immediate double-start, (2) send Idempotency-Key for Start RPCs, (3) server-side short dedupe cache (10s) keyed on acct+idempotency-key.

mike: agree with 10s TTL; 2s too small given GC/network spikes. also prefer server to return 409 or a ResumeHint when duplicate detected.

ira: SDK change: attach Idempotency-Key by default for Start calls; include resume_token only when doing a true resume. docs should make the distinction explicit.

zoe: i'll add idempotency + jitter to sample-app and include a stress script. quick test reduced dupes from ~9% to ~0.9%. opening draft PR.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging cluster-02 at 2026-03-10T11:00Z.

phil: follow-ups: zoe PR + repro steps, runtime team to prototype dedupe cache + metrics, SDK team to add jitter + default idempotency in next minor. create tracking tickets.
